task:
REVISE THE F4 DESIGN DOC FOR THREE SMALL FOLLOW-UP REVIEW FINDINGS (PR #801). Target branch codex/run-38015883683-1, expected head 422d38d; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md may change. Verify claims against the code (cite file:line); extend 'Review dispositions (2026-10-10)' with items 19-21.

19. (P2, ~line 604) 'Report the Any-mode navigation cap': Any mode with a committed anchor (500-ly search) can return an exact total above 10,000 (local_search.py caps counts only for galaxy-wide requests — cite the lines), yet the shared URL/facade rule refuses offsets >= 10,000. CHANGE: apply the 10,000 navigation ceiling only to selected rankings; for Any mode expose a separate navigable_total / truncation state derived from the local-search response (reuse its existing total_is_capped field if present — cite) so the UI never advertises rows that Next cannot reach.

20. (P2, ~line 604) 'Normalize offsets that exceed the returned total': a stale/shared URL may carry offset=9950 while total=3; the endpoint returns an empty page with a positive total, but the empty state would claim no systems meet the tier. CHANGE: when offset >= total (and total > 0), the UI clamps to the last valid page (offset = floor((total-1)/page_size)*page_size), rewrites the URL via replaceState, and shows a one-line 'page reset' notice; only total == 0 shows the genuine no-match state. Add this to F4b's unit/component tests.

21. (P3, ~line 325) 'Keep radio descriptions out of the accessible name': placing the description inside each radio's <label> AND referencing it with aria-describedby announces it twice. CHANGE: the label holds only the short archetype name; the one-line description lives in a separate element referenced by aria-describedby.

Validation: git diff --name-only origin/main lists only the design doc; Markdown renders. Commit message: 'docs(finder): F4 design — Any-mode navigation cap, out-of-range offset reset, radio accessible names'.
